description: This file defines a Projects API client for a frontend application, providing functions to fetch project summaries from a backend service. It includes an exported function getProjectsSummary that constructs API requests with appropriate query parameters and headers based on provided options.

methods.name: getProjectsSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of projects created within a specified time range, with support for custom date ranges. It constructs query parameters and headers based on input, interacting with an API client to retrieve data.
